summary: Vertical Aerospace Ltd. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a circular and press release for its 2026 annual general meeting (AGM) to be held September 11, 2026. The circular includes the AGM notice, a letter to shareholders, and a proxy form for resolutions to be adopted. The record date is August 18, 2026. This is a routine AGM notice under Rule 13a-16; no special-situation event such as an acquisition, tender offer, or strategic review is indicated.
